description: Agent402 Bond, buyer side. Sign an `open` transaction that the seller built and signed as fee payer (base64, legacy). Before signing, the instruction is rebuilt for this wallet from its own terms and must match byte for byte (one instruction, seller and this wallet as the only signers, USDC or an enabled PREQ deal). Rules: seller in X402_BOND_SELLERS, price at most X402_BOND_MAX_USD (PREQ: X402_BOND_MAX_PREQ_ATOMIC), seller bond at least X402_BOND_MIN_SELLER_BOND_BPS (default 5%), delivery within X402_BOND_MAX_DAYS (default 30), the deposit within the daily cap of its asset, and human confirmation (by default always). Empty settings refuse everything. Locks this wallet's deposit in the deal vault.
name: bond_open
